turns.text: Make ONE still image, widescreen 16:9, photorealistic: the first frame of a classroom scene. Five pictures are attached and are the references: student-teacher.jpg is the TEACHER (the man in the grey long-sleeve shirt), web-evan.jpg is EVAN (the young man with braids), web-maya.jpg is MAYA (the young woman with the fringe; no umbrella, no props, she is a student at a desk), web-leo.jpg is LEO (the young man in the old black-and-white portrait; render him in colour as a present-day student in casual clothes, keeping his face and hair), and student-classroom.jpg is the CLASSROOM (the scene must be this room: these desks, these windows, this green board). The frame: morning light from the windows; the teacher stands in the aisle beside Evan's desk handing him a test paper face down; Evan is seated at an aisle desk looking up at it; Maya sits at the next desk; Leo sits beside Maya. Each person must look exactly like their picture and the room exactly like its photo. No text on the image.

item.tests: the four people match their pictures, the room matches its photo, the score reads 38/100, the actions in order

The room is the classroom in student-classroom.jpg.
